# I Sketch Interiors

> Luxury interior design studio based in Thane, Maharashtra, India. Specialising in bespoke residential interiors across Mumbai, Pune, and internationally. Founded in 2000, over 20 years of experience, 125+ completed projects.

## Key facts

- Brand name: I Sketch Interiors
- Alternate names: ISketch Interiors, ISketch, I Sketch
- Founded: 2000
- Experience: 20+ years, 125+ completed projects
- Studio: The Courtyard, Asteria A/604, Pokhran Road No. 2, Thane West, Maharashtra 400601, India
- Phone: +91 99673 12203, +91 98925 15655
- Email: studio@isketchinteriors.com
- Website: https://isketch.in
- Price range: Luxury / high-end ($$$$)
- Languages: English, Hindi, Marathi

## Service area

- Primary: Thane, Mumbai, Navi Mumbai
- Secondary: Pune, wider Maharashtra
- International: projects across India and internationally on a selective basis

## Services

- **Full Interior Design** — Comprehensive service from initial concept through to final installation. Includes space planning, material selection, custom furniture design, and coordination with contractors. Pricing: percentage-based on project scope.
- **Consultation** — Expert guidance on specific areas of your interior: colour schemes, furniture layouts, lighting design, material choices. Pricing: hourly rate.
- **Property Styling** — Staging solutions for pre-sale or rental properties. Curated furnishings and accessories to maximise appeal to buyers or tenants. Pricing: fixed fee.
- **Bespoke Joinery** — Custom-designed cabinetry, built-in storage, kitchen cabinetry, bathroom vanities, and statement pieces. Made by master craftsmen. Pricing: per project quote.

## Featured projects

- **Belgravia Townhouse**, London — 6,500 sq ft Georgian townhouse renovation
- **Surrey Country Estate** — 12,000 sq ft country estate redesign
- **Dubai Penthouse** — 8,000 sq ft contemporary luxury penthouse
- **Chelsea Apartment**, London — 2,200 sq ft pied-à-terre
- **Kensington Kitchen**, London — 450 sq ft bespoke kitchen
- **Notting Hill Residence**, London — 4,800 sq ft townhouse transformation
